item-projects.title: Using genAI (openAI) with RAG (ChromaDB, Milvus) to accelerate the development of data pipelines running on pyspark and databricks
item-projects.description: Designed and implemented a genAI system with RAG (ChromaDB/Milvus) to automate and accelerate the development of data pipelines, enabling seamless transformation of source tables to target tables with varying data structures.
highlights: Prompt engineering and tuning to generate PySpark data-pipeline functions together with their unit tests

Curated the retrieval corpus from the enterprise data dictionary - source and target schemas, column-level lineage and prior transformation examples - embedded with OpenAI embeddings into HNSW-indexed vector collections spanning thousands of table definitions

Tuned the retrieval layer rather than only the prompt: chunk granularity, top-k depth and similarity thresholds, measured against whether the generated PySpark compiled and passed its generated tests, which mattered more to output quality than further prompt iteration

Operated the vector store as shared infrastructure - collection layout, embedding refresh on schema change, and reproducible rebuilds from source - so retrieval quality did not silently decay as the data dictionary evolved, holding sub-second retrieval at interactive latencies
Closed the generate-test-repair loop: a failing unit test fed straight back into the next generation attempt, so the pipeline converged on compiling, passing PySpark without hand re-prompting
